name: Somchai Srisuwan
bio:
Somchai Srisuwan's journey to motorsport finance was somewhat unconventional. He initially trained as a chartered accountant, excelling in auditing and financial analysis. However, a lifelong passion for racing, fueled by watching Formula 1 as a child, led him to seek an opportunity to combine his professional skills with his personal interests. He started in a smaller racing team before landing a role at Walkinshaw Andretti United. 

Somchai's meticulous approach to financial management is crucial to the team's success. He focuses on ensuring compliance, optimizing resource allocation, and providing data-driven insights to improve financial performance. Known for his calm demeanor and ability to handle pressure, Somchai is a key player in maintaining the financial stability of the team. His unique blend of Thai heritage and Western financial training allows him to bridge cultural gaps and foster effective communication within the diverse team environment.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight side part
physical.description: Somchai is of average height with a lean build, always impeccably dressed in business attire.

quirks: Always carries a traditional Thai amulet for good luck.
Keeps a detailed spreadsheet of every expense, no matter how small.
Drinks copious amounts of iced Thai coffee throughout the day.
